chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Safwan, from al-‘Ala’, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two of them, peace be upon them, who said:
I asked him about a man performing wudu (ablution): should he pass water through the inner part of his beard? He said: "No."

key_terms.أَ يُبَطِّنُ: whether he should make water reach the inner part
key_terms.لَا: no; indicating negation of the requirement

ai.seo_question: Is a man required to wash beneath his beard during wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling related to wudu (ablution). It indicates that a man performing wudu is not required to make water reach the inner part of the beard.
